purpose: Collapsible labelled bucket inside side-navigation that groups related side-navigation-item entries under a single heading.
useWhen: Splitting a long side-navigation column into clearly named sections.
Letting users collapse rarely used groups to reduce visual noise in the sidebar.
Sectioning an app's navigation with no visible headings: collapsible false plus labelVisibility hidden keeps the name for screen readers.

avoidWhen.reason: Used outside a side-navigation ancestor — it expects that landmark for context.
Hosting a single flat list with no grouping — place side-navigation-item entries directly.
